title: Load inspectable Agent Skills on demand
description: Use the Agent Skills SKILL.md format for a small configured set of local skills. Discover metadata first and load the body only when relevant. Record source/version, allow disable and show why a skill was selected. Validate referenced paths and apply the same execution scopes to any scripts. Detect conflicting instructions. A loaded skill is not permission to run every bundled command.
why: Reusable procedures should be portable and should not consume context unnecessarily.

acceptance.text: An irrelevant skill is not fully injected
A relevant skill is traceable to its source
A disabled or invalid skill is not executed
Skill instructions cannot override user constraints or expand authority

outcome.summary: Added progressive-disclosure Agent Skills support: metadata-only discovery from project-local SKILL.md folders, explicit per-task loading with reason/source/version, disabled and invalid skill rejection, thread-level declared-conflict detection, path validation for referenced resources, and an untrusted-instructions boundary. Bundled scripts are never executed by the loader.
